extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.31[CR]- Use a compact cinematic preview and a five-column, two-row content grid with matching black backgrounds.[CR]- Bundle 26 Movies/TV genre choices using real public title-art pairs; no runtime requests for genre artwork.[CR]- Prioritize visible artwork over queued speculative image downloads.[CR]- Preload missing leading descriptions while choosing a genre and merge prepared metadata before binding cards.[CR]- Display remaining time and episode identifiers; update native progress indicators during fresh In Progress reconciliation.[CR]- Keep the confirmed native list binding after playback; place frozen refresh artwork above the opaque background.[CR]- Add native title context actions and full descriptions, with an explicit Play from beginning option.[CR]- Back from a genre catalog returns to its genre picker; TV season/episode hierarchy and early paging remain.[CR]- Use strong white focus outlines and a contrasting focused season selector while preserving top-menu glow artwork.[CR]- Record presentation configuration, image-priority cancellations, native binding retention and title actions in diagnostics.[CR]- Remove 20 unreferenced legacy category illustrations from the install package.

extension.description: Delivers updates for the standalone Prime Scene add-on. The index is now hosted by ScottyWins.
